### CVE-2004-0380
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2004-04-06 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 23695: Microsoft Internet Explorer 5.0.1 - ITS Protocol Zone Bypass (MS04-013) (remote/windows, 2004-02-13, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 23400: Microsoft Outlook Express 6.0 - '.MHTML' Forced File Execution (1) (remote/windows, 2003-11-25, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 23401: Microsoft Outlook Express 6.0 - MHTML Forced File Execution (2) (remote/windows, 2003-11-25, verified=1)

The MHTML protocol handler in Microsoft Outlook Express 5.5 SP2 through Outlook Express 6 SP1 allows remote attackers to bypass domain restrictions and execute arbitrary code, as demonstrated on Internet Explorer using script in a compiled help (CHM) file that references the InfoTech Storage (ITS) protocol handlers such as (1) ms-its, (2) ms-itss, (3) its, or (4) mk:@MSITStore, aka the "MHTML URL Processing Vulnerability."
